correctness.rationale: The six coordinate equations are equivalent to the twisted matrix identity. Explicit diagonal-zero and resonance cases partition all q^6 choices of A, including the offdiagonal compatibility corrections in double-resonance cases. Their contributions exactly yield each N_d and sum to q^6; weighted summation yields the pair count. Complete exact-arithmetic finite field enumerations at q=4,5,7 matched every N_d for eight twist choices. The proof covers arbitrary permitted q; experiments are supporting checks only.

value.rationale: This is a complete, field-uniform calculation of all possible outgoing twisted-neighborhood sizes in the smallest upper-triangular matrix size where the graph is weakly connected, together with exact multiplicities and arc density. The order independence, including characteristic two and root-of-unity twists, is a structural uniformity not evident from general connectivity statements. It is a motivated natural invariant rather than a selected isolated test case.
